mira: Hey team — I'm the new on-call shadow this week (hi 👋). Quick blockers: I can't access PagerDuty (403 when I try to view incidents). Who should I ping?

samir: @mira welcome! Did you accept the PagerDuty invite from Okta? Usually the error means the PD app isn't provisioned. Ping @ops-iam if it still fails.

lena: Note: sometimes IT blocks come from missing SCIM group. @mira, open a ticket in #help-it and tag @ops-iam. If you need to follow an incident immediately, use the emergency fallback account documented in the runbook (short-lived creds).

sre-oncall-bot: PagerDuty rotation update: mira assigned as shadow -> primary for rotation starting 2026-03-23 08:00 UTC. Rotation link: https://pd.internal/redwood/rotations/42 (access controlled)

omar: Runbooks & quick start: https://confluence.internal/redwood/oncall/runbooks — start with the "Immediate Triage" section. Minimal checklist below (also in runbook):

```
ONCALL HANDOFF CHECKLIST:
1) Confirm PagerDuty + Slack notifications are working
2) Open CloudWatch / Grafana dashboards for services on rotation
3) Validate alerting channels (#incidents, #eng-oncall)
4) Ensure you can SSH to jumpbox + have AWS read-only role
5) Read the recent 24h incidents and PMs
```

mira: Thanks — I'm in #help-it now. One other question: how aggressive should I be about paging infra for latency alerts? I don't want to over-escalate during noisy deploys.

samir: Good Q. Rule of thumb in runbook: for p99 latency > 2s sustained for 5m -> page infra. For 5xx error rate > 5% for 3m -> page. If it's a deploy window, add the deploy tag and follow the deploy rollback checklist first before paging, unless customer-facing errors persist.

mira: Got it. Pairing: can someone shadow me through a mock incident today at 15:00 UTC? I want to run through the full flow (alert -> triage -> escalate -> postmortem sketch).

omar: I'll pair at 15:00. Plan: simulate an alert, run through runbook steps, practice PD escalation, and create a skeleton postmortem. Meet in #eng-oncall and I'll DM calendar invite.

lena: Also DM @ops-iam to get the IAM role 'oncall-shadow' added for read-only AWS console access. That avoids sharing real creds.

samir: Postmortem template (short snippet) — full template in Confluence: https://confluence.internal/redwood/postmortems

```
POSTMORTEM TEMPLATE (snippet):
- Summary (what happened)
- Impact (users, customers)
- Timeline (events)
- Root cause
- Actions (owner + ETA)
- Follow-ups & detection improvement
```

mira: Perfect, thanks everyone. One last FYI: saw a deploy-bot note about a prod rollout at 16:35 UTC — will that affect today's drill?

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy to prod: service-search at 2026-03-23T16:35:00Z. If a critical alert triggers during deploy, follow the deploy rollback path before broad escalation unless customer impact is severe.

mira: Cool — I'll aim for the 15:00 drill and then standby for the deploy window. Appreciate the fast help! :rocket:
